entities.summary: Esmailin Manuel Caridad is a Dominican former professional right-handed pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Chicago Cubs, in Nippon Professional Baseball for the Hiroshima Toyo Carp and in the Korea Baseball Organization for the Samsung Lions.
